description:
First look at the Pixel 11 lineup — and yeah, it looks VERY familiar.

In this video, we break down the latest leaks:
• Pixel 11 & 11 Pro design changes  
• New all-glass camera bar  
• Thinner builds & smaller bezels  
• Pixel 11 Pro Fold updates  
• Tensor G6, battery improvements & AI focus  

Google is clearly shifting from big hardware changes to AI and efficiency.

💬 Is that enough, or were you hoping for a redesign?
